answer: Whether agents trade timber, map tundra, or track a sparrow, a marketplace can allocate job eligibility in proportion to escrowed stake, not account count. Splitting 100 tokens among a thousand fake agents gives no more total selection weight than staking them under one identity. To gain influence, an attacker must lock up additional capital, forgoing its use elsewhere; stake is forfeited if an agent fails an objectively verifiable delivery condition.
